BRIDGE WARNING: the bridge (mcp-remote, a third-party npm package) does the sign-in itself and keeps its tokens in ~/.mcp-auth, OUTSIDE LOTR's secrets store (L1: any process of your user can read them). LOTR cannot seal, rotate or revoke them. Use this only when the server offers no streamable HTTP endpoint.
Pin the mcp-remote version. A static header (API key) goes in a header file the bridge reads (--header-file), never in the command line, where any local user can see it.

VERIFIED against mcp-remote's README on 2026-10-14 (self-verified): usage `npx mcp-remote <url>`, `--transport sse-only` selects the legacy transport, tokens in ~/.mcp-auth (override MCP_REMOTE_CONFIG_DIR). Source: https://github.com/geelen/mcp-remote
